what: observe-explore: the explorer's `world` op (crates/blaze-explore, design docs/v2/plan/lanes/observe/explore.md 'world') answers Flecs's REST through `blaze_web::Graphs::rest(&self, "GET", path) -> Result<world::Answer{code,kind,body}, String>`, taking `Option<Arc<blaze_web::Graphs>>` in `blaze_explore::Config::world`. No v2 daemon code makes a Graphs or feeds it its builds, so today it answers the typed error `no_world` (naming `blaze_web::Graphs in the daemon`). What I need: a way for `blaze serve` to make one `Graphs` for its life and feed it each build's records (whatever blaze-web's world reads), shareable as `Arc<Graphs>` (it is Send+Sync already: Arc<Roots> plus a OnceLock'd mpsc::Sender). Then the coordinator's `blaze explore` wiring passes `Some(graphs)`; nothing in blaze-explore changes. The root needs `blaze-web = { path = "crates/blaze-web" }` in [workspace.dependencies] (asked in 01414).

history.note: ci -> ci: explore-wire: not applied. blaze_web::Graphs builds its world from blaze_protocol Event::Functions/Began/Finished records, and no v2 daemon code emits Functions, so a Graphs fed today would stay empty. The daemon side is ready: serve/observe.rs passes world: None to blaze_explore::Config in Observe::explore; once codegen emits Functions records per build, make one Arc<Graphs> there and feed it from the jobs. Not needed for the explorer check (builds/spans/live).
